Joe Biden says that Republicans want “Medicare and Social Security to sunset.”

That’s a flat out LIE.

The Biden admin has weaponized the Federal Insurance Office to implement its woke Green New Deal agenda in the regulation of each state’s insurance market. 

My Federal Insurance Office Elimination Act will DEFUND the ever-expanding agency & return oversight back to the states.

✅Last week, I reintroduced the Federal Insurance Office Elimination Act.

Defunding the ever-expanding agency is a good step towards draining the D.C. swamp and returning oversight back to the states.

During the pandemic, bad actors stole hundreds of billions in unemployment insurance payments, leaving Americans struggling.

That’s why last week, @HouseGOP passed legislation that will recover fraudulent payments & bring the criminals who defrauded Americans to justice.

During the pandemic, bad actors stole hundreds of billions of dollars in taxpayer-funded unemployment insurance payments.

That’s wrong, which is why @HouseGOP PASSED the Protecting Taxpayers and Victims of Unemployment Fraud Act to recover these funds & prevent future fraud.

We made a promise to take care of those who have taken care of us. 

That’s why the @HouseGOP-passed FY24 MilConVa bill FULLY FUNDS Veterans’ healthcare, Veterans’ benefits, and VA programs. 🇺🇸

🚗Motor vehicle insurance is UP 18.9%
🚗Motor vehicle repair is UP 10.2%
🚗Transportation services are UP 9.1%

Whether it’s by car, train, or plane, “Bidenomics” is hurting Americans.
It was a pleasure to tour New Horizons Healthcare in Roanoke and learn about the important work they do to provide quality medical care to folks in the Star City. https://t.co/VhWGAn99Eg

💡 Electricity prices are up 25%
🍎 Food prices are up 20.2%
🏠 Rent prices are up 18.6%
🚗 Car insurance is up 20.3%

That’s “Bidenomics”.

Since June, our national debt ballooned from $32 trillion to $34 trillion. We're adding $1 trillion roughly every 100 days. It's a glaring sign we need immediate budget reforms that protect Social Security and Medicare for future generations while reducing deficits that are leading us over the looming fiscal cliff.

https://t.co/K5P5IlO65S

While the President’s budget continues to pile on debt and deficits into perpetuity, the House budget passed last week which: 

• Achieves balance in 10 years while preserving Social Security and Medicare for current and future generations. 
• Reduces the debt by $14 trillion over ten years. 
• Achieves a $45 billion surplus by 2034.

Yesterday, I was proud to join House Republicans in passing the FY25 Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act.

Unfortunately, the Democrats voted against this crucial funding for our veterans’ healthcare and benefits. We will continue to fight for those who fought for us.

Another deception from the Biden Admin... The Inflation Reduction Act pledged to reduce costs for life-saving drugs. 

The reality: Medicare Part D premiums skyrocketed up to 21% while plan options plummeted. Our seniors deserve more than this Admin’s empty promises.

The cost of a new car has revved up by nearly $10,000 and auto insurance prices are up by 19.5% since the Biden-Harris Admin took office.

VP Kamala Harris co-owns the soaring inflation that has wrecked all Americans’ finances. https://t.co/27YLBPBQFC

I have had a great few days on my three-day healthcare tour across Virginia's Sixth District. 

We are fortunate to have outstanding hospitals, clinics, and dedicated care providers committed to serving our communities. By visiting these facilities and hearing from our doctors, nurses, and healthcare professionals, I can better advocate for their needs and those of the citizens who rely on them and ensure those on the front lines have a strong voice in the policymaking process.

In some states, car insurance premiums are expected to soar by over 50%.

For the past 4 years, hardworking Virginians' finances have been flattened by the failed economic policies pushed by the Biden-Harris Admin.

https://t.co/lOYKxgXqWG

The Chinese Communist Party is an existential threat to America, and this Administration has only empowered and emboldened them.

We must take immediate action to safeguard Americans’ sensitive healthcare data from the CCP before they fully infiltrate our economy, universities, and federal contracts.

As we recognize #RuralHealthDay , we applaud our incredible healthcare professionals and dedicated hospitals serving our rural communities, as these heroes work tirelessly to provide critical care while facing unique challenges. We must continue to work to expand access to quality health care in rural Districts like ours.

The Biden Admin’s HHS wasted $850,000 imposing radical ideology on military families instead of addressing critical healthcare issues like supporting homeless veterans. This isn’t just egregious—it’s a blatant misuse of taxpayer dollars. It’s high time to end this waste in our government.

Congratulations to @ScottCentorino , a VA-06 resident, for being appointed by President Trump as his special assistant for domestic policy. Scott previously served as an Army JAG lawyer and has an exceptional background in healthcare reform. I wish him the best of luck in this new role in the Trump Administration.

Florida spent nearly $660 million on healthcare for illegal immigrants in 2024 alone.

That’s 67,700 ER visits and $76.6 million in Medicaid payments, all paid for by hardworking American taxpayers.

If one state spent this much in just one year, how much did this cost American healthcare systems across the entire country?

https://t.co/I4OPOita4Z

Since 2023, 6,300 illegal immigrants with criminal records or are on the FBI’s Terrorist Screening Center have been paroled into the U.S. under Joe Biden.                                                   

905 collected Medicaid. 41 collected unemployment. 22 received student loans. Total cost to taxpayers? $598,000.                                                                                                                                

Biden didn’t just open the border — he handed out your tax dollars to criminals and terrorists.

Thank you to the Virginia representatives from @IndAgent for stopping by my office today. We had a great conversation about supporting the insurance industry and the small businesses that depend on it through pro-growth policies and commonsense tax reform. I appreciate their insight and the important work they do across the Commonwealth.

I joined @FoxNews to highlight how the One Big Beautiful Bill puts our military first—investing $9 billion to improve quality of life through increases in allowances and special pays, better housing, improved healthcare, and stronger support for military families.

This Memorial Day weekend, we remember the heroes who gave everything for our freedom.

I was honored to receive @NAMIC’s Benjamin Franklin Public Policy Award today, presented by David B. Johnson of Augusta Mutual, in recognition of my work on behalf of the insurance industry. I’ll keep fighting for commonsense reforms that strengthen insurers and protect policyholders.
